content: To create a calculator page, follow these detailed steps: 1. Select a Topic: Begin by choosing a topic of interest from a list of the most commonly used risk scores. Assign an appropriate name to the selected topic. You can click on the provided link to select a topic. 2. Before Creating a Page: Ensure that you use the official name of the risk score or criteria as listed in the index article. If there are multiple scores with the same name, create a landing page that includes links to the respective pages for each score. For instance, the Wells score may refer to several variations, such as: Wells score for DVT (original) Wells score for DVT (modified) Wells score for PE (original) Wells score for PE (modified) 3. Create a Page: Use the designated template specifically designed for calculator pages to create the page. 4. Create a Widget: Utilize the template for calculator widget pages. Replace placeholders such as names, variables, and values with the appropriate information. Finally, insert the widget code into the page to complete the process.
